title: Onboard echo-3b-v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Malik
description:
Motivation: Add first-class support for the open-source echo-3b-v1.0 model to the registry. This PR adds standardized metadata, a set of verified performance profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, and wires the model into our changelog/release-notes automation so onboarding events produce consistent release entries.

What this PR does:
- Adds model metadata (authors, license, weights URI, tokenizer, architecture) and versioning fields.
- Includes performance profiles (latency and throughput) for GPU and CPU targets derived from lab runs (see perf-profiles/bench-*.json).
- Adds quantization compatibility notes and recommended default quantized profile.
- Integrates the model into the automated changelog generator (scripts/changelog-generator) so onboarding triggers a release note entry.
- Updates registry index and model catalog metadata to expose echo-3b via API and Console.

Checklist:
- [x] Model metadata schema validated (schema/v1)
- [x] Perf profiles generated and smoke-tested on perf-canary infra
- [x] Changelog automation hook added and exercised in CI dry-run
- [x] Docs snippet added to model-catalog README

Notes and links: model weights are referenced by signed URI (s3://redwood-models/echo/echo-3b-v1.0.tar.gz) access gated by model-registry RBAC. Linear tickets: ENG-2134 (onboarding), ENG-2189 (perf validation). Support ticket SUP-4421 contains a request for echo support in a pilot customer test.

Testing summary: See commits for bench-run artifacts and CI output. Local smoke tests: generation latency for 512 tokens on a V100 baseline measured ~68ms median per-token (tail under investigation vs. Aurora-3b). Changelog automation was validated by running the dry-run in CI which produced the expected markdown entry (attached as artifacts).

release_notes: Added echo-3b v1.0 to model registry. Includes metadata, recommended quantized profile, and performance profiles for typical inference workloads. Integrated with changelog automation to generate release notes on onboarding.
changelog_automation: The onboarding hook registers a structured entry with the changelog-generator. The hook writes a single markdown fragment to /ci/artifacts/changelog-fragments/echo-3b-v1.0.md and triggers the generator dry-run in CI. The automation ensures a standardized release note with model name, version, short description, license, and perf summary.
notes: Perf profiles were derived from controlled runs on perf-canary with deterministic seed. Tail latencies for 1024 tokens show higher variance vs internal baselines; follow-up ENG ticket (ENG-2198) opened to investigate scheduling/kv-cache impact.
security_review: Keys and URIs are stored as references; the PR does not include private keys or weight blobs. RBAC rules required to access the model are documented in models/echo/metadata.json under access_controls.
manual_steps: Consumers: after merge, run registry sync (scripts/registry_sync.py --model echo-3b-v1.0) to populate downstream catalogs if you operate a cached mirror. For Private deploys, ensure the signed URI is available in the customer S3 namespace.
